343: If he merits [it], God creates him in the image of Metatron, a servant beneath his Master. And that is [the meaning of] that, God created man in His/his image (Genesis 1:27), in that mold. But if he does not merit [it], it is the image of Samael. We learned he is the angel of death under the authority of the Holy One, blessed be He, to judge people in Gehinnom through him unless one is righteous.
